metadata.title: The Aunt's Auction
metadata.subtitle: Grandma wasn't buried a week before Aunt Margaret put my heirloom jade ring up for auction.

nodes.text: 10:05 AM · Six days after Grandma’s funeral. An estate appraiser you met once texts you urgently.
{{player_name}}, your Aunt Margaret just listed an imperial jade bangle as Lot #14 at 1 PM—engraved inside with YOUR initials.
Aunt Margaret! Why is Grandma’s jade bangle in an auction catalog?! That was left to me!
Lucas, move the auction up to noon and hide the blue velvet box before {{player_name}} gets here!
Don’t be greedy, {{player_name}}. Without a written inventory, everything in Grandma’s house belongs to the estate executor—me.

nodes.transcript: [hushed] Your grandmother visited my shop three months ago. She registered that bangle's provenance certificate directly in your name—and left a copy in my vault.

nodes.prompt: The private auction starts in 90 minutes. How do you stop her?

options.label: Grab the provenance certificate & rush over
options.player_reply_text: Hold that certificate, Mr. Chen! I am picking you up in ten minutes.

options.label: File a stolen-property alert with police
options.player_reply_text: Selling registered property without owner consent is grand theft. Let’s bring a detective.

nodes.text: Certificate in hand. No reputable auction house will touch Lot #14 once they see this seal.
POLICE ESCORT READY: Because the imperial jade is valued at $180,000, the Property Crimes unit assigns two officers immediately!
Hey {{player_name}}, chill out—Mom just needed cash to cover my restaurant lease. Don’t make a scene!
Bidding starts at noon sharp. Don’t bother showing up—the gate guards have orders not to let you in.

nodes.headline: Going Once, Going Twice...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: The auctioneer raises the gavel for Lot #14—right as the manor doors swing wide open.

nodes.text: 12:08 PM · Grandma’s Parlor. Velvet ropes, twenty wealthy collectors. The gavel hovers over Lot #14.
Sold for $195,000! Wait—who let {{player_name}} past the front gate?!
Freeze the sale! Anyone who buys Lot #14 is buying documented stolen property.
Mom, the buyer in the front row is pulling his check back!!

nodes.transcript: [authoritative] Ladies and gentlemen, inspect the inner rim with a loupe. It bears {{player_name}}’s initials and my notarized registry transfer from three months ago.

nodes.prompt: Aunt Margaret drops the velvet box in panic. What is your verdict?

options.label: Reclaim the bangle & strip her executorship
options.player_reply_text: Hand over the bangle, Aunt Margaret. And my lawyer is petitioning to remove you as executor today.

options.label: Open the false bottom inside the jade box
options.player_reply_text: Wait—Grandma told me this blue box has a false velvet bottom. Let’s see what you almost sold.

nodes.text: Collectors file out in disgust. You slip Grandma’s cool jade bangle safely onto your wrist.
HIDDEN DEED FOUND: Tucked beneath the velvet lining is the original deed to Grandma’s manor—signed over exclusively to {{player_name}}!
No... no! She left you the entire house?! We have nowhere to go!
Pack your auction signs, Aunt Margaret. Grandma’s house is closed for business.

nodes.headline: Heirloom Reclaimed
nodes.teaser_text: Inside the manor deed is a handwritten note from Grandma: "Beware whoever asks about the cellar safe."

nodes.text: 11:48 PM · Grandma’s Manor. Grandma’s handwritten warning about the cellar safe suddenly comes alive.
{{player_name}}, wake up! My phone just got a motion alert from the manor cellar—and Mom’s car isn’t in our driveway!
Grandma literally wrote: "Beware whoever asks about the cellar safe." Aunt Margaret is down there RIGHT NOW!

nodes.caption: CELLAR MOTION CAM · 11:46 PM — A silhouette carrying a flashlight toward Grandma’s stone vault.

nodes.text: {{player_name}}, I just finished inspecting your jade ring under UV light! The inner band isn’t decoration—it’s an engraved 6-digit safe combination!
This locksmith better crack the dial before midnight or my buyer walks—

nodes.transcript: [footsteps on gravel] I’m pulling up to the manor side gate now! There’s a white locksmith van parked behind the hedges—Mom really hired someone to drill the safe!

nodes.prompt: Margaret is trying to drill Grandma’s vault! How do you stop her?

options.label: Call police for breaking & entering
options.player_reply_text: I’m the legal owner on the manor deed—calling police for active burglary right now!

options.label: Sound the manor alarm & lock cellar gate
options.player_reply_text: Lucas, flip the cellar floodlights and trip the manor alarm—keep her right there until police arrive!

nodes.text: SIRENS OUTSIDE: The locksmith drops his drill and bolts when patrol headlights sweep the courtyard.
BLINDING LIGHTS: Floodlights snap on, catching Aunt Margaret holding a crowbar beside Grandma’s untouched safe.
You called the police on your own aunt?! I was just checking for dampness in the cellar!
Nobody checks for dampness with a diamond-tip safe drill at midnight, Margaret. Meet me at the cellar tomorrow—we’re opening it properly.

nodes.headline: What Lies Inside Grandma’s Vault?
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: Use the jade ring’s hidden UV code to open the cellar safe—and discover why Margaret was desperate.

nodes.text: 10:00 AM · Manor Cellar. With police witness present, you dial the 6 digits hidden inside your jade ring.
CLICK! The vault door swung open! Oh my word… {{player_name}}, do you know what is sitting inside that rosewood box?!
A matching imperial jade pendant, a ledger of antique deeds—and a letter addressed to me!
Wait—why is there a private auction catalog stuffed in Mom’s purse with a photo of THAT exact pendant?!
I already took a $150,000 advance from the overseas collector for that pendant—
Good heavens! This matching imperial jade set is museum-grade—appraised at $1.4 MILLION! That’s why Margaret tried to steal your ring first!

nodes.transcript: [papers unfolding] {{player_name}}, Grandma’s letter says Aunt Margaret took an illegal deposit from an underground auction broker last month—BEFORE Grandma even passed!

nodes.prompt: Margaret threatens to claim Grandma was senile unless you hand over the pendant! Your move?

options.label: Read Grandma’s notarized letter aloud
options.player_reply_text: Grandma had her doctor AND notary witness this letter—she knew you’d try to sell it before her funeral.

options.label: Report her illegal pre-sale to auction board
options.player_reply_text: Mr. Chen, send the cellar burglary report and pre-sale receipt straight to the International Auction Guild!

nodes.text: SPEECHLESS: Margaret sinks onto a wine crate as Mr. Chen seals the jade set in an armored appraisal case.
BLACKLISTED: The broker immediately cancels the deal and demands his $150K advance back from Margaret!
You sold your own mother’s heirloom while she was still breathing, Aunt Margaret.
I have a signed consignment contract! If I don’t deliver that pendant by 5 PM they’ll take my house!

nodes.headline: The Consignment Contract Surfaces
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: Inspect the forged consignment contract Margaret signed—with YOUR name on it.

nodes.text: 2:15 PM · Mr. Chen’s Appraisal Gallery. The auction broker just faxed the contract Margaret signed.
{{player_name}}, look at the bottom line of this consignment contract—Margaret forged YOUR signature as co-owner!

nodes.caption: FORGED CONSIGNMENT · Unauthorized sale of Imperial Jade Set ($1.4M) bearing a falsified heir signature.

nodes.text: Please {{player_name}}, just confirm the signature so they don’t arrest me! I’ll give you half the auction money!
You forged my name to sell Grandma’s soul for cash. Not a chance in hell, Margaret.
Lucas won’t even answer my calls anymore, I’m completely alone—

nodes.transcript: [sighing heavily] {{player_name}}, I just gave the police my statement confirming Mom practiced your signature at our kitchen table. Do what’s right—protect Grandma’s legacy.

nodes.prompt: The auction house voids the contract and asks what you want done with the $1.4M jade set.

options.label: Keep the jade set in the family bank vault
options.player_reply_text: Seal the ring and pendant together in a private bank vault—it stays in our family forever.

options.label: Loan it to the City Museum in Grandma’s name
options.player_reply_text: Keep ownership in our family—and loan the set to the City Museum with a plaque honoring Grandma!

nodes.text: PRESERVED FOREVER: Mr. Chen logs the heirloom into the protected family registry—untouchable by any broker.
MUSEUM HONOR: The curator accepts immediately with full insurance—Grandma’s name will shine for generations.
Your grandmother chose the exact right guardian, {{player_name}}.
Mom’s broker dropped the house lien after she turned over her jewelry to repay him—and she’s facing probation for the forgery.

nodes.headline: Grandma’s Legacy Safe
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Finale): Reopen Grandma’s manor with Lucas and unveil the jade heirloom in her honor.

nodes.text: One Month Later · City Heritage Gallery. Warm spotlights illuminate a velvet display case bearing Grandma’s name.
Over two hundred guests came to see the Imperial Jade exhibition tonight, {{player_name}}! Your grandmother would be beaming.
It feels right seeing it celebrated instead of hidden in a dark cellar—or sold off for greed.
Thank you for still inviting me tonight, {{player_name}}. After everything Mom did, I half expected you to cut us both off.
Saw the newspaper photo of the jade exhibition—Grandma was right about {{player_name}}—

nodes.transcript: [soft applause] The museum director is calling you up to the podium to say a few words about your grandmother!

nodes.text: Stepping up now. Lucas, come stand beside me—you helped save this too.

nodes.prompt: Your closing dedication from the gallery podium:

options.label: Dedicate the exhibit to Grandma’s wisdom
options.player_reply_text: Grandma taught me that true heirlooms aren’t measured in carats—they’re measured in the integrity of who keeps them.

options.label: Turn Grandma’s manor into a heritage salon
options.player_reply_text: And this fall, Lucas and I are opening Grandma’s manor gardens as a free heritage library for young artisans!

nodes.text: STANDING APPLAUSE: The gallery echoes with applause as the jade gleams softly under the glass.
LIVING TRIBUTE: Mr. Chen pledges his entire antique reference collection to your new library on the spot.
Grandma’s smiling down on us tonight, {{player_name}}.
A masterpiece of jade—and an even finer heir.

nodes.headline: FINALE · Guardian Of The Jade
nodes.teaser_text: You thwarted the midnight auction, opened Grandma’s vault, and honored her legacy for generations.
